threads.body: Closing a started async request coroutine while its SDK await is pending now leaves the invocation unfinished: `activate()` re-raises `GeneratorExit` without failing it, unlike the removed `except BaseException`. Preserve a direct-call lifetime guard around activation that finalizes coroutine closure before stream ownership transfers, without changing the shared wrapper's normal stream-close behavior. The same regression affects the migrated async guards in OpenAI Responses, Portkey, Google Interactions, Bedrock, Agno, and Anthropic.

replies.body: Fixed in util instead of per wrapper: `activate()` now fails the invocation on `GeneratorExit`, so a coroutine closed mid-await ends its span as failed in every instrumentation: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/pull/1096/commits/f263b0c86a801e0fc6d64aa805a755f5d9eaf81c

threads.body: Please add sync and async public-client regression tests for `generate_content_stream()` raising before it returns a stream. Existing streaming error tests defer failure until iteration, so they do not protect this setup-time span-leak fix (also at line 916). Assert unchanged exception propagation, exactly one error span with the expected `error.type`, and restoration of caller context, following the [instrumentation test rules](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/instrumentation/AGENTS.md#tests).
should we rename this `attach_to_context` since it seems like a public facing attribute now >?

threads.body: The raw-response hooks remain installed after a body read, `parse()`, or stream exhaustion finishes the invocation. This helper then reattaches the ended span on later reads or closes, so nested instrumented work can inherit that span instead of the caller's current context. Use a shared non-failing activation scope that skips finished invocations, preserving the existing fallback finalization behavior, and cover read/parse followed by close for both clients.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", _OPERATIONS)
+def test_span_is_current_only_during_the_call(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tracer_provider: TracerProvider,
+    meter_provider: MeterProvider,
+    logger_provider: LoggerProvider,
+    span_exporter: InMemorySpanExporter,
+    operation: str,
+) -> None:
+    resource_type, method_name, make_response, call_sdk = _CASES[operation]
+    seen: list[Span] = []
+    original = getattr(resource_type, method_name)
+
+    @wraps(original)
+    def call(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> Any:
+        seen.append(trace.get_current_span())
+        return make_response()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(resource_type, method_name, call)
+    with instrument(
+        GoogleGenAiSdkInstrumentor(),
+        tracer_provider=tracer_provider,
+        meter_provider=meter_provider,
+        logger_provider=logger_provider,
+        content_capture="NO_CONTENT",
+    ):
+        before = context.get_current()
+        call_sdk(Client(api_key="test-key"))
+        assert context.get_current() is before
+
+    (span,) = span_exporter.get_finished_spans()
+    assert [s.get_span_context() for s in seen] == [span.context]
+
+

+def _assert_single_error_span(span_exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
+    (span,) = span_exporter.get_finished_spans()
+    assert span.status.status_code == trace.StatusCode.ERROR
+    assert (span.attributes or {})["error.type"] == "ValueError"

+def test_generate_content_stream_error_before_stream_is_returned(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tracer_provider: TracerProvider,

+    logger_provider: LoggerProvider,

+        GoogleGenAiSdkInstrumentor(),
+        tracer_provider=tracer_provider,
+        meter_provider=meter_provider,
+        logger_provider=logger_provider,
